name: East Entrance to Mushroom Town
overview_text: East Entrance to Mushroom Town is a hunting ground in Maple Road, Maple Island in MapleStory Classic. Monsters here include Tutorial Jr. Sentinel. Monsters are around level 1. There are 6 monster spawn points.

meowdb_spawn_estimates.note: MeowDB's own spawn/EXP model (page 'Map Summary' and 'How this estimate works'); not raw game data. Monster level/EXP live in the monsters domain.

spawn_rules_text: How spawns work. The server runs a global 7.56s respawn tick across every loaded map. After a mob dies its spawn point waits a cooldown (5s default, or usually the WZ mobTime value for timed spawns), then the mob reappears on the next tick. Field-boss schedules are server-owned, so unconfirmed live-timing windows are labelled when they differ from the raw map value. Map capacity scales with players on the map: 75% solo, +5% per extra player, capping at 100% from 6 players. This map has 6 spawn points, so capacity is ~5 concurrent mobs solo and 6 in a full party. Mob rate (0.6x) multiplies that capacity: expect about 4 monsters up at a time. Not applied to the figures above yet; best reading from closed-beta play.
mob_rate_text: About mob rate. Mob rate multiplies how many monsters this map keeps alive at once. This map has 6 spawn points and a mob rate of 0.6x, so expect about 4 monsters up at a time instead of 6. The spawn figures above do not apply it yet. This is our best reading from closed-beta play, where a high-rate map held far more monsters than it has spawn points; an exact whole-map count has not been done.

to_portal.derivation: reverse lookup: the unique portal in the destination map whose to_map_id is this map; "none" when no such portal exists

bounds_px_derived.derivation: x in [-center_x_px, width_px - center_x_px], y in [-center_y_px, height_px - center_y_px] (viewer formula left% = (x + miniMapCenterX) / minimapWidth)

notes: mob_rate is 0.6. MeowDB pages disagree on its effect: this page says it multiplies how many monsters stay alive ("best reading from closed-beta play", not applied to its own estimates); the spawn-engine guide says MapleStory Classic ignores it and the spawn formula page's capacity formula omits it. See docs/canonical/maps.md, Discrepancies.

isTown is true but the page prose calls this map "a hunting ground" and the header shows monster facts instead of "Map type: Town" (the prose follows whether the map has monsters). is_town keeps the structured isTown value.
gaps: to_portal (destination portal name) is not given by MeowDB; derived by reverse lookup (see to_portal_derivation).
Portal "type" is a raw integer; MeowDB does not label its meaning on the page or in the viewer code.
No foothold/platform/ladder/rope geometry is published on the page (only point positions and the minimap rectangle).
MeowDB does not say whether npc/spawn y is the raw WZ life y or the foothold-snapped y.
